result.stdout:
Usage:
  graphify-csharp [<input>] [export options]       Export JSON (default)
  graphify-csharp export [options]                  Export JSON
  graphify-csharp watch [options]                   Start a warm session
  graphify-csharp query <verb> [options]            Query semantic evidence
  graphify-csharp refresh --instance <id>          Refresh a warm session
  graphify-csharp ps [--json]                       List warm sessions
  graphify-csharp info <id|prefix> [--json]         Inspect a warm session
  graphify-csharp diagnostics <id|prefix> --output <path>
  graphify-csharp stop <id|prefix> [--json]        Stop a warm session

Work from disk:
  Omit --input for export/watch when the current root contains one
  solution (.sln/.slnx), or one project (.csproj) when no solution exists.
  Disk export defaults to ./graphify-out/csharp.json.

Warm sessions:
  watch is output-free and prints its session ID before loading completes.
  Route query, refresh, and export explicitly with --instance <id|prefix>.
  No command attaches to a session by matching input or output paths.

Use '<command> --help' for command-specific options and examples.

result.stdout:
Usage: graphify-csharp export [--input <solution|project|file.cs>] [options]
       graphify-csharp [<input>] [options]

When --input is omitted, one unambiguous solution or project is discovered
directly under --root (or the current directory).

Output defaults to ./graphify-out/csharp.json under the caller's current
directory; use --output to choose another destination.

Options:
  -i, --input <path>              C# solution/project/file-based app to export
  -r, --root <path>               Repository root for stable paths
  -o, --output <path>             Graphify JSON output path (default: ./graphify-out/csharp.json)
  -c, --configuration <name>      MSBuild configuration (default: Debug)
  -f, --target-framework <tfm>    Select one TFM when target selection is ambiguous
      --rebuild                  Ignore incremental cache and rebuild all projects
      --json                     Write one structured result to stdout
      --no-progress              Suppress progress messages on stderr
  -h, --help                      Show this help

result.stdout:
Usage: graphify-csharp watch [--input <solution|project|file.cs>] [options]

Starts an output-free foreground semantic session. Use ps to find the session
and query/refresh/export with --instance <id|prefix>. If --input is omitted,
one unambiguous solution or project is discovered directly under --root
(or the current directory).

Options:
  -i, --input <path>              C# solution/project/file-based app to watch
  -r, --root <path>               Repository root for stable paths
  -c, --configuration <name>      MSBuild configuration (default: Debug)
  -f, --target-framework <tfm>    Select one TFM when target selection is ambiguous
      --watch-scan-interval <t>   Backup inventory interval (default: 00:05:00)
      --no-progress              Suppress progress messages on stderr
  -h, --help                      Show this help
